blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 USP ⟨161⟩ 的適用範圍：哪些醫療器材必須進行內毒素與熱原檢測
blocks.en: Understand the scope of USP ⟨161⟩: which medical devices must be tested for endotoxin and pyrogens

blocks.zh: 區分器材（device）與藥品（drug product）的內毒素限值來源：⟨161⟩ vs ⟨85⟩
blocks.en: Distinguish where endotoxin limits come from for devices versus drug products: ⟨161⟩ vs ⟨85⟩

blocks.zh: 掌握器材內毒素限值計算公式：Result = (K × N) / V
blocks.en: Master the device endotoxin limit calculation: Result = (K × N) / V

blocks.zh: 了解標準萃取方法的條件：37 ± 1.0°C、NLT 1 小時、BET 用水
blocks.en: Know the conditions of the standard extraction method: 37 ± 1.0°C, NLT 1 hour, BET water

blocks.zh: 認識 Kit（套組）與 Product Family（產品族）的分組測試邏輯
blocks.en: Understand the grouping logic for testing kits and product families

blocks.zh: 理解 CDMO 中 RTU 容器系統和 PFS 的 ⟨161⟩ 合規要求
blocks.en: Understand the ⟨161⟩ compliance requirements for RTU container systems and PFS in a CDMO

blocks.zh: Introduction — 適用範圍與器材分類
blocks.en: Introduction: Scope and Device Classification

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 ⟨161⟩ vs ⟨85⟩ 的關係
blocks.en: Core Concept: How ⟨161⟩ Relates to ⟨85⟩

blocks.zh: USP ⟨85⟩ 是細菌內毒素試驗（BET）的「方法學通則」— 它定義了凝膠法（gel-clot）、動力學法（kinetic）和終點法（endpoint）的操作程序、標準品和對照。
blocks.en: USP ⟨85⟩ is the general methodology chapter for the bacterial endotoxins test (BET). It defines the procedures, standards, and controls for the gel-clot, kinetic, and endpoint methods.

blocks.zh: USP ⟨161⟩ 則是專門針對醫療器材的應用章節。它告訴你：
blocks.en: USP ⟨161⟩ is the application chapter written specifically for medical devices. It tells you:

blocks.zh: 哪些器材必須做 BET
blocks.en: Which devices must undergo BET

blocks.zh: 每個器材的內毒素限值是多少
blocks.en: What the endotoxin limit is for each device

blocks.zh: 如何萃取器材表面的內毒素
blocks.en: How to extract endotoxin from the device surface

blocks.zh: 如何計算萃取液的內毒素限值
blocks.en: How to calculate the endotoxin limit for the extract

blocks.zh: 簡單說：⟨85⟩ 告訴你「怎麼測」，⟨161⟩ 告訴你「測什麼、限值多少」。
blocks.en: In short: ⟨85⟩ tells you "how to test"; ⟨161⟩ tells you "what to test and what the limit is."

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 游泳池的水質檢測：
blocks.en: Testing swimming pool water:

blocks.zh: 想像 ⟨85⟩ 是一本「水質檢測方法手冊」— 教你怎麼用試劑檢測水中細菌。而 ⟨161⟩ 則像是「游泳池管理法規」— 規定不同類型的泳池（兒童池、深水池、SPA 池）各自的水質標準是多少，以及取樣方式（從哪裡取水、取多少）。
blocks.en: Think of ⟨85⟩ as a "water quality testing methods manual" that teaches you how to use reagents to detect bacteria in water. ⟨161⟩ is more like the "pool management regulation": it sets the water quality standard for each type of pool (children's pool, deep pool, spa) and the sampling approach (where to draw water and how much).

blocks.zh: 你不能只拿「方法手冊」就去測泳池 — 你還需要知道「這個池子的合格標準是什麼」。同樣地，器材的 BET 不能只看 ⟨85⟩，必須同時遵守 ⟨161⟩ 的限值和萃取要求。
blocks.en: You cannot test a pool with just the methods manual; you also need to know what the pass criterion is for that pool. In the same way, device BET cannot rely on ⟨85⟩ alone; you must also follow the limits and extraction requirements of ⟨161⟩.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 CDMO 關聯性
blocks.en: Key Point: CDMO Relevance

blocks.zh: 為什麼 CDMO 需要了解 ⟨161⟩？
blocks.en: Why does a CDMO need to understand ⟨161⟩?

blocks.zh: 當你的產品是組合產品（Combination Product）時 — 例如預充填注射器（PFS）、自動注射器（autoinjector）、藥物塗層支架 — 藥品部分遵守 ⟨85⟩，器材部分遵守 ⟨161⟩。
blocks.en: When your product is a combination product (for example a prefilled syringe (PFS), an autoinjector, or a drug-coated stent), the drug part follows ⟨85⟩ and the device part follows ⟨161⟩.

blocks.zh: 特別是 RTU（Ready-to-Use）容器系統：
blocks.en: This applies in particular to RTU (ready-to-use) container systems:

blocks.zh: PFS 玻璃管（barrel）+ 柱塞（plunger）+ 針頭護套 — 這些都是器材組件
blocks.en: PFS glass barrel + plunger + needle shield: these are all device components

blocks.zh: RTU 小瓶（vials）和注射器套巢（nest & tub）— 作為器材包裝，需要符合 ⟨161⟩
blocks.en: RTU vials and syringe nest & tub: as device packaging, they must meet ⟨161⟩

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 客戶可能要求你提供這些組件的 BET 資料
blocks.en: Your CDMO customers may ask you to provide BET data for these components

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一個 PFS 預充填注射器，它的「藥液」部分和「注射器器材」部分，分別適用 ⟨85⟩ 還是 ⟨161⟩？限值怎麼定？
blocks.en: For a prefilled syringe (PFS), do the "drug solution" part and the "syringe device" part fall under ⟨85⟩ or ⟨161⟩ respectively? How is the limit set?

blocks.zh: 如果你的客戶送來一批 RTU 小瓶，要求你做充填前的內毒素測試，你應該參考哪個 USP 章節來設定限值？
blocks.en: If a customer sends you a batch of RTU vials and asks for endotoxin testing before filling, which USP chapter should you refer to when setting the limit?

blocks.zh: Definitions — 內毒素限值與關鍵定義
blocks.en: Definitions: Endotoxin Limits and Key Definitions

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 內毒素限值體系
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Endotoxin Limit System

blocks.zh: 器材的限值邏輯與藥品完全不同：
blocks.en: The limit logic for devices is completely different from that for drugs:

blocks.zh: 藥品（⟨85⟩）：限值基於劑量 — 5 EU/kg/hr（靜脈注射），以病人體重和給藥速率計算
blocks.en: Drug products (⟨85⟩): the limit is dose-based: 5 EU/kg/hr (intravenous), calculated from patient body weight and rate of administration

blocks.zh: 器材（⟨161⟩）：限值基於每個器材 — 固定 20 EU/device，與病人體重無關
blocks.en: Devices (⟨161⟩): the limit is per device: a fixed 20 EU/device, independent of patient body weight

blocks.zh: 腦脊液接觸器材：更嚴格 — 2.15 EU/device（因為血腦屏障對內毒素極度敏感）
blocks.en: Devices contacting cerebrospinal fluid (CSF): stricter: 2.15 EU/device (because the central nervous system is extremely sensitive to endotoxin)

blocks.zh: 這個差異反映了一個實務現實：藥品的內毒素量可以根據濃度和劑量精確計算，但器材的內毒素來自表面殘留，與器材大小和接觸面積有關，用「每個器材」作為單位更直觀。
blocks.en: This difference reflects a practical reality: the endotoxin quantity in a drug product can be calculated precisely from concentration and dose, but endotoxin on a device comes from residue on its surface and depends on device size and contact area, so "per device" is the more intuitive unit.

blocks.zh: 公式拆解 Limit Calculation
blocks.en: Formula Breakdown: Limit Calculation

blocks.zh: Result = (K × N) / V — 讓我們用一個實際例子來理解：
blocks.en: Result = (K × N) / V. Let us work through a practical example:

blocks.zh: 假設你要測試 3 支 PFS barrel（一般器材，非腦脊液接觸）：
blocks.en: Suppose you are testing 3 PFS barrels (a general device, not CSF-contacting):

blocks.zh:
K = 20 EU/device
N = 3 devices
V = 120 mL（3 支 × 每支用 40 mL 萃取液）

Result = (20 × 3) / 120 = 0.5 EU/mL
blocks.en:
K = 20 EU/device
N = 3 devices
V = 120 mL (3 barrels × 40 mL of extract each)

Result = (20 × 3) / 120 = 0.5 EU/mL

blocks.zh: 也就是說，萃取液的內毒素濃度必須 < 0.5 EU/mL 才算合格。
blocks.en: In other words, the endotoxin concentration of the extract must be < 0.5 EU/mL to pass.

blocks.zh: 注意：萃取體積 V 可以根據器材大小和構型調整 — 但必須記錄並驗證。
blocks.en: Note: the extraction volume V may be adjusted to the size and configuration of the device, but the choice must be documented and validated.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Product Family 的邏輯
blocks.en: Analogy: The Logic of a Product Family

blocks.zh: 同款不同尺碼的衣服：
blocks.en: Clothes of the same style in different sizes:

blocks.zh: 想像你是一家服裝品質檢測實驗室。客戶送來同款式的 T 恤，有 S、M、L、XL 四個尺碼。你需要做品質測試，但不可能每個尺碼都單獨做完整驗證。
blocks.en: Imagine you run a garment quality testing laboratory. A customer sends T-shirts of the same style in four sizes: S, M, L, and XL. You need to run quality tests, but you cannot realistically run a full validation on every size separately.

blocks.zh: USP ⟨161⟩ 的做法是：選最大尺碼（XL）來做代表性測試 — 因為表面積最大，理論上內毒素殘留風險最高。如果 XL 合格了，較小尺碼應該也沒問題。
blocks.en: The approach of USP ⟨161⟩ is to choose the largest size (XL) for representative testing, because it has the greatest surface area and so, in theory, the highest risk of endotoxin residue. If XL passes, the smaller sizes should be fine too.

blocks.zh: 同理，器材的 Product Family 以「最大表面積」的成員作為代表進行適用性測試。
blocks.en: Likewise, for a device product family, the member with the "largest surface area" is used as the representative for suitability testing.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Kit 的測試挑戰
blocks.en: Key Point: Testing Challenges for Kits

blocks.zh: Kit（套組）是最容易搞混的類別。一個手術套組可能包含多種不同器材，每種器材可能有不同的內毒素限值。
blocks.en: Kits are the category most easily confused. A surgical kit may contain many different devices, and each may have a different endotoxin limit.

blocks.zh: USP ⟨161⟩ 給了兩個選項：
blocks.en: USP ⟨161⟩ gives two options:

blocks.zh: 分別測試每種有非致熱原聲稱的器材 — 各自適用各自的限值
blocks.en: Test separately each device that carries a non-pyrogenic claim, with each device subject to its own limit

blocks.zh: 合併測試所有項目 — 但限值計算會更複雜
blocks.en: Pool and test all items together, though the limit calculation then becomes more complex

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的 RTU 容器套巢中，nest + tub + cap 的組合也可視為一種 kit — 你的客戶可能要求你對每個組件單獨報告數據。
blocks.en: In a CDMO's RTU container nest, the combination of nest + tub + cap can also be regarded as a kind of kit, and your customer may ask you to report data for each component separately.

blocks.zh: 計算題：5 支腦脊液接觸器材（intrathecal catheter），每支用 20 mL BET 水萃取，萃取液合併測試。請計算萃取液的內毒素限值（EU/mL）。
blocks.en: Calculation exercise: 5 intrathecal catheters (CSF-contacting devices) are each extracted with 20 mL of BET water, and the extracts are pooled for testing. Calculate the endotoxin limit of the extract (EU/mL).

blocks.zh: 你的工廠生產三種尺寸的 RTU 小瓶（2 mL、5 mL、10 mL），材質和製程相同。若要建立 Product Family 進行適用性測試，你會選哪個尺寸作為代表？為什麼？
blocks.en: Your plant produces RTU vials in three sizes (2 mL, 5 mL, 10 mL) with the same material and process. If you set up a product family for suitability testing, which size would you choose as the representative, and why?

blocks.zh: Table 1 列出四種 Product Unit 情境。請用一個 PFS 套組（barrel + plunger + needle shield + backstop）的例子，判斷它屬於哪種情境，應如何測試？
blocks.en: Table 1 lists four product unit scenarios. Using a PFS kit (barrel + plunger + needle shield + backstop) as the example, decide which scenario it falls under and how it should be tested.

blocks.zh: Extraction Methods — 萃取方法與條件
blocks.en: Extraction Methods: Methods and Conditions

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 萃取的科學邏輯
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Science Behind Extraction

blocks.zh: 為什麼需要「萃取」？
blocks.en: Why is "extraction" needed?

blocks.zh: 內毒素是脂多醣（LPS），它會黏附在器材表面。你不能直接把器材放進 LAL 試劑裡測 — 必須先用水把表面的內毒素「洗下來」，然後測這個洗液。
blocks.en: Endotoxin is lipopolysaccharide (LPS), which adheres to device surfaces. You cannot simply put the device into LAL reagent; you must first use water to "wash off" the endotoxin from the surface and then test that wash solution.

blocks.zh: USP ⟨161⟩ 規定了兩種萃取方式：
blocks.en: USP ⟨161⟩ specifies two extraction approaches:

blocks.zh: 浸泡法（Soak / Immerse）：適用於外表面有非致熱原聲稱的器材，如植入物、骨基質
blocks.en: Soak / Immerse: for devices with a non-pyrogenic claim on the outer surface, such as implants and bone matrix

blocks.zh: 沖洗法（Flush）：適用於有流體通道的器材，如導管、輸液套組、PFS 內腔
blocks.en: Flush: for devices with a fluid pathway, such as catheters, infusion sets, and the PFS lumen

blocks.zh: 關鍵條件：37 ± 1.0°C 的 BET 水、接觸 NLT 1 小時。這模擬了體溫條件下內毒素從器材表面溶出的過程。
blocks.en: Key conditions: BET water at 37 ± 1.0°C, with contact for NLT 1 hour. This simulates the dissolution of endotoxin from the device surface at body temperature.

blocks.zh: 泡茶的原理：
blocks.en: The principle of brewing tea:

blocks.zh: 萃取器材上的內毒素就像泡茶 — 你需要：
blocks.en: Extracting endotoxin from a device is like brewing tea. You need:

blocks.zh: 合適的水溫（37°C，不是沸水 — 太熱會破壞某些器材材質）
blocks.en: The right water temperature (37°C, not boiling water, since excessive heat can damage some device materials)

blocks.zh: 足夠的浸泡時間（至少 1 小時，讓「茶味」充分釋出）
blocks.en: Enough soaking time (at least 1 hour, so the "flavor" is fully released)

blocks.zh: 適當的水量（太少泡不出東西，太多稀釋到測不到）
blocks.en: An appropriate amount of water (too little and nothing comes out; too much and it is diluted below detection)

blocks.zh: 而且你必須讓水接觸到器材的所有聲稱非致熱原的表面 — 就像泡茶時茶葉必須完全浸入水中，不能有部分露在外面。
blocks.en: You must also make sure the water contacts all surfaces that carry a non-pyrogenic claim, just as tea leaves must be fully submerged in the water, with no part left sticking out.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 CDMO 實務考量
blocks.en: Key Point: Practical CDMO Considerations

blocks.zh: RTU 容器和 PFS 的萃取挑戰：
blocks.en: Extraction challenges for RTU containers and PFS:

blocks.zh: PFS barrel：內腔是流體通道 — 用沖洗法，但要確保萃取液接觸到整個內壁，包括錐頭（Luer cone）部分
blocks.en: PFS barrel: the lumen is the fluid pathway, so use the flush method, but make sure the extract contacts the entire inner wall, including the Luer cone

blocks.zh: RTU 小瓶：通常用浸泡法或注入萃取液後搖晃 — 需要驗證萃取效率
blocks.en: RTU vials: usually extracted by soaking, or by filling with extract and shaking; extraction efficiency must be validated

blocks.zh: Nest & Tub：多個小瓶的巢穴和外盒，表面積大，萃取體積的選擇很關鍵
blocks.en: Nest & tub: the nest and outer tub for multiple vials have a large surface area, so the choice of extraction volume is critical

blocks.zh: 合併測試（Pooling）：多個器材的萃取液合併後測試 — 這能提高效率，但要確保計算公式中的 N 和 V 正確對應
blocks.en: Pooling: extracts from several devices are combined and tested together. This improves efficiency, but you must make sure N and V in the calculation formula correspond correctly

blocks.zh: 滅菌前 vs 滅菌後取樣：如果你在滅菌前取樣測 BET（可以更早放行），必須用滅菌後樣品驗證等效性。而且，如果產品支持微生物生長（如含糖溶液的器材），則不可使用滅菌前測試。
blocks.en: Pre-sterilization vs post-sterilization sampling: if you sample before sterilization for BET (allowing earlier release), you must demonstrate equivalence using post-sterilization samples. In addition, if the product supports microbial growth (for example a device containing a sugar solution), pre-sterilization testing must not be used.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Sample Size 限制
blocks.en: Key Point: Sample Size Limit

blocks.zh: USP ⟨161⟩ 規定常規測試取樣數量 NMT 10（不超過 10 個）。這跟藥品不同 — 藥品通常固定取樣量。
blocks.en: USP ⟨161⟩ sets the sample size for routine testing at NMT 10 (no more than 10 units). This differs from drug products, where the sample quantity is usually fixed.

blocks.zh: 取樣數量取決於：
blocks.en: The sample size depends on:

blocks.zh: 批量大小
blocks.en: Lot size

blocks.zh: 製程控制水平
blocks.en: Level of process control

blocks.zh: 統計考量
blocks.en: Statistical considerations

blocks.zh: 歷史表現
blocks.en: Historical performance

blocks.zh: 如果你的製程穩定且有良好歷史記錄，可以用較少的樣品數。但替代取樣計劃必須有完整的風險評估支持。
blocks.en: If your process is stable and has a good history, you can use fewer samples. However, an alternative sampling plan must be supported by a complete risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 工廠收到一批 PFS barrel（1 mL 長針型），需要測試 BET。請描述完整的萃取流程：用什麼溶劑？什麼溫度？接觸時間多長？如何確保萃取液接觸到所有內表面？
blocks.en: Your CDMO plant receives a batch of PFS barrels (1 mL long, staked-needle type) that need BET. Describe the complete extraction procedure: which solvent, what temperature, how long is the contact time, and how do you make sure the extract contacts all inner surfaces?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP ⟨161⟩ 規定萃取液溫度是 37°C 而不是室溫或更高溫度？從科學和實務兩個角度說明。
blocks.en: Why does USP ⟨161⟩ specify an extract temperature of 37°C rather than room temperature or a higher temperature? Explain from both a scientific and a practical perspective.

blocks.zh: 情境題：客戶要求你對 RTU nest & tub 進行「滅菌前 BET 放行」以加速交貨。你需要做哪些額外驗證才能建立這個流程？
blocks.en: Scenario: a customer asks you to do "pre-sterilization BET release" for RTU nest & tub to speed up delivery. What additional validation do you need to do to establish this process?

blocks.zh: Suitability Testing — 適用性試驗
blocks.en: Suitability Testing

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 干擾因子的雙面性
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Two Sides of Interfering Factors

blocks.zh: 器材萃取液可能含有各種溶出物（leachables）— 塑化劑、矽油、金屬離子、膠體 — 這些物質可能干擾 LAL 試劑的反應：
blocks.en: Device extracts may contain various leachables (plasticizers, silicone oil, metal ions, colloids) that can interfere with the LAL reaction:

blocks.zh: 抑制（Inhibition）：萃取物質抑制 LAL 反應 → 測到的內毒素偏低 → 假陰性風險 — 這是最危險的情況
blocks.en: Inhibition: extracted substances inhibit the LAL reaction, so the measured endotoxin is too low, creating a false-negative risk. This is the most dangerous situation.

blocks.zh: 增強（Enhancement）：萃取物質促進 LAL 反應 → 測到的內毒素偏高 → 假陽性風險 — 導致合格產品被拒絕
blocks.en: Enhancement: extracted substances promote the LAL reaction, so the measured endotoxin is too high, creating a false-positive risk that leads to rejection of acceptable product.

blocks.zh: 葡聚醣（β-Glucan）干擾：某些器材材料（如纖維素基材、某些凝膠）可能釋出 β-glucan，它會觸發 LAL 反應中的 Factor G 途徑，造成假陽性。解決方案：使用葡聚醣阻斷劑或內毒素專一性 LAL 試劑。
blocks.en: Glucan (β-glucan) interference: some device materials (such as cellulose-based materials and certain gels) may release β-glucan, which triggers the Factor G pathway in the LAL reaction and causes false positives. Solutions: use a glucan-blocking agent or an endotoxin-specific LAL reagent.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 MVD 的意義
blocks.en: Analogy: What MVD Means

blocks.zh: 稀釋就像調雞尾酒：
blocks.en: Dilution is like mixing a cocktail:

blocks.zh: 如果器材萃取液干擾了 LAL 反應，最簡單的解決方法就是「稀釋」— 把干擾物質濃度降到不影響的程度。但稀釋也會同時降低內毒素濃度，稀釋太多就測不到了。
blocks.en: If the device extract interferes with the LAL reaction, the simplest remedy is dilution, which lowers the concentration of the interfering substance until it no longer interferes. But dilution also lowers the endotoxin concentration, and if you dilute too far you can no longer detect it.

blocks.zh: MVD 就是你能稀釋的「上限」— 確保稀釋後的內毒素濃度仍然在試驗靈敏度（λ）範圍內。就像調雞尾酒時，你可以加冰塊稀釋酒精，但加太多冰就變成水了。
blocks.en: The MVD is the "upper limit" of how far you can dilute. It ensures that the endotoxin concentration after dilution is still within the sensitivity (λ) range of the test. It is like mixing a cocktail: you can add ice to dilute the alcohol, but add too much and it becomes just water.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 適用性的持續維護
blocks.en: Key Point: Ongoing Maintenance of Suitability

blocks.zh: 適用性不是「做一次就好」— USP ⟨161⟩ 明確要求在以下情況重新評估：
blocks.en: Suitability is not "do it once and you are done." USP ⟨161⟩ explicitly requires re-evaluation in the following situations:

blocks.zh: 產品設計變更
blocks.en: Product design change

blocks.zh: 製程變更
blocks.en: Process change

blocks.zh: 原材料供應商變更
blocks.en: Change of raw material supplier

blocks.zh: 生產/測試地點變更
blocks.en: Change of manufacturing or testing site

blocks.zh: BET 試劑來源變更
blocks.en: Change of BET reagent source

blocks.zh: 萃取技術變更（必須重新做適用性研究）
blocks.en: Change of extraction technique (suitability studies must be repeated)

blocks.zh: BET 方法變更（如從凝膠法改為動力學顯色法）
blocks.en: Change of BET method (for example from gel-clot to kinetic chromogenic)

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，這意味著每次客戶的器材組件供應商變更，你都需要評估是否需要重新做適用性測試。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, this means that every time a customer changes the supplier of a device component, you need to assess whether suitability testing must be repeated.

blocks.zh: 計算題：器材萃取液的內毒素限值為 0.5 EU/mL，你使用的 LAL 試劑靈敏度 λ = 0.03 EU/mL。請計算 MVD 值。如果適用性測試在 1:4 稀釋時通過，這個稀釋倍數是否在 MVD 允許範圍內？
blocks.en: Calculation exercise: the endotoxin limit of a device extract is 0.5 EU/mL, and the sensitivity of your LAL reagent is λ = 0.03 EU/mL. Calculate the MVD. If the suitability test passes at a 1:4 dilution, is this dilution factor within the allowed MVD range?

blocks.zh: 一款矽油塗層的 PFS barrel，萃取液出現明顯的 BET 抑制現象。除了稀釋之外，你還能採取哪些措施來克服干擾？
blocks.en: A silicone-oil-coated PFS barrel shows clear BET inhibition in its extract. Besides dilution, what other measures can you take to overcome the interference?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: USP ⟨161⟩ 的定位：專門針對醫療器材的 BET 應用章節，與 ⟨85⟩（方法學）和 ⟨151⟩（熱原試驗）形成完整體系
blocks.en: Position of USP ⟨161⟩: the BET application chapter specific to medical devices, forming a complete system with ⟨85⟩ (methodology) and ⟨151⟩ (pyrogen test)

blocks.zh: 適用範圍：標示為無菌且非致熱原、直接或間接接觸心血管系統、淋巴系統或腦脊液的器材
blocks.en: Scope: devices labeled sterile and non-pyrogenic that contact the cardiovascular system, the lymphatic system, or cerebrospinal fluid, directly or indirectly

blocks.zh: 內毒素限值：一般器材 ≤ 20 EU/device；腦脊液接觸 ≤ 2.15 EU/device；眼內環境可能更低
blocks.en: Endotoxin limits: general devices ≤ 20 EU/device; CSF-contacting ≤ 2.15 EU/device; the intraocular environment may be lower

blocks.zh: 限值公式：Result = (K × N) / V — 將每個器材限值轉換為萃取液濃度限值
blocks.en: Limit formula: Result = (K × N) / V, which converts the per-device limit into an extract concentration limit

blocks.zh: 標準萃取條件：BET 水、37 ± 1.0°C、接觸 NLT 1 小時、浸泡或沖洗
blocks.en: Standard extraction conditions: BET water, 37 ± 1.0°C, contact NLT 1 hour, soak or flush

blocks.zh: Product Family 策略：以最大表面積成員為代表，減少重複驗證工作
blocks.en: Product family strategy: use the member with the largest surface area as the representative to reduce repeated validation work

blocks.zh: CDMO 關鍵點：組合產品（PFS、autoinjector）的器材部分需遵循 ⟨161⟩，而非 ⟨85⟩ 的藥品限值邏輯
blocks.en: Key CDMO point: the device part of a combination product (PFS, autoinjector) follows ⟨161⟩, not the drug-product limit logic of ⟨85⟩
